_comment: AWS Amplify app configuration for deployment-ui.
_staging_note: Staged in unified-trading-pm/scripts/aws/ui-deployment/. Copy to deployment-ui/.aws/ when that repo is available. Apply via: aws amplify create-app --name uts-deployment-ui-prod --cli-input-json file://deployment-ui-amplify-app-config.json
